artifacts.summary: 11-phase implementation plan discharging DP-2 via a structural IWorldHist creation-history invariant and the mint-time snapshot-free residue, with an explicit go/no-go gate at Phase 5

memory_candidates.content: When a formal-proof plan has exactly one unproven research-grade step that everything else depends on, hoist that step out of the phase that would consume it and give it its own phase as a STANDALONE lemma with all of its inputs supplied as explicit hypotheses. The consuming phase then discharges those hypotheses from local context. This converts a late, expensive failure (crux fails only after hundreds of lines of invariant threading are built on top of it) into an early, cheap go/no-go gate, and it makes the gate's exit criteria checkable in isolation: 'the conclusion's free variables contain no branch/state snapshot' is a mechanical read-back test. The pattern also localizes the [BLOCKED] instruction to one phase instead of diffusing it across a large phase where partial progress is hard to characterize.
